environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway REST API. LaunchDarkly project 'prod-services' has flag 'enhanced-profile-parser' configured with targeting OFF and off-variation index 0 pointing to boolean false. The flag's fallthrough value is also set to variation index 0 (false). The flag has a prerequisite dependency on flag 'legacy-migration-complete' which is itself targeting OFF. Additionally, the LaunchDarkly environment-level kill switch 'enhanced-parsers-global' is in OFF state with a stale-flag policy that auto-disables flags not explicitly re-enabled within 14-day windows. The SDK is initialized with a read-only service token scoped to the 'lambda-consumers' environment segment which cannot modify flag state.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validation models
config.stale_flag_policy: auto-disable after 14 days without explicit re-enable
